XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.EDI.XML.Document' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Segment' sourceDocType='ALLER:AllergyInfo' targetDocType='2.3:PID' create='new' language='objectscript' > <trace value='"In PID sub transform"' /> <assign value='source.{patientIdInfo.encNum}' property='target.{PatientAccountNumber.ID}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{patientIdInfo.mpiNum} '= ""' > <true> <assign value='..Pad(source.{patientIdInfo.mpiNum},-10,"0")' property='target.{PatientIDInternalID().ID}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='..Pad(source.{patientIdInfo.mrNum},10,"0")' property='target.{PatientIDInternalID().ID}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='..Pad(source.{patientIdInfo.mrNum},6,"0")' property='target.{AlternatePatientID.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{patientVisitInfo.patName.last}' property='target.{PatientName.familyname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{patientVisitInfo.patName.first}' property='target.{PatientName.givenname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{patientVisitInfo.patName.middle}' property='target.{PatientName.middleinitialorname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{patientVisitInfo.patName.title}' property='target.{PatientName.suffix}' action='set' /> <assign value='$EXTRACT(source.{patientVisitInfo.sex}, 1,1)' property='target.{Sex}' action='set' /> <assign value='$EXTRACT(source.{patientVisitInfo.dob}, 1, 8)' property='target.{DateofBirth}' action='set' /> <assign value='""' property='target.{PatientDeathIndicator}' action='set' /> </transform>
